from collections import deque

def comps(grid, bg=8, row_lo=0,row_hi=None,col_lo=0,col_hi=None):
    R=len(grid); C=len(grid[0]); row_hi=R if row_hi is None else row_hi; col_hi=C if col_hi is None else col_hi
    seen=set(); result=[]
    for r in range(row_lo,row_hi):
      for c in range(col_lo,col_hi):
        if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)];seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
